metadata.title: On the Collatz Conjecture via Meaning Supremacy System Axioms
metadata.description: We present a proof framework for the Collatz (3n+1) conjecture using the Meaning Supremacy System (MSS) v15.2 axioms. Three theorems are established: (1) boundedness of all Collatz trajectories via heat-tax minimization (Axiom A3); (2) non-existence of non-trivial cycles of length a≤68 via MSS independent enumeration (a≤14) combined with Simons & de Weger's established result (a≤68); (3) conditional convergence of all bounded cycle-free trajectories to the unique invariant set {1,4,2}. The existence of cycles with a≥69 remains an open problem. The proof uses elementary discrete mathematics throughout. All numerical claims are verifiable via the accompanying Python verification script (collatz_cycle_verifier.py, 2.3×10^6 combinations enumerated).
metadata.notes: Preprint. Honest boundary: a≤68 closed, a≥69 open. Includes verifiable Python enumeration code.
